title: VP of Marketing

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: This role within HP's Large Format Printing business unit owns the go-to-market strategy, customer education, and value proposition messaging for HP's outdoor graphics and signage printer portfolio. HP already markets 'outdoor durability,' 'graphics that withstand the test of time,' and 'white ink that resists yellowing'—messaging that directly aligns with Tedlar's value propositions. The VP of Marketing would be interested in Tedlar as a case study and co-marketing partner to substantiate HP's durability claims with third-party validated data. This role cares about: (1) Proof points and customer success stories - demonstrating measurable ROI for HP customers who use validated finishing materials, (2) Thought leadership and industry positioning - establishing HP as the authority on durable outdoor graphics through educational content and technical partnerships, (3) Lead generation at industry events - creating compelling booth experiences and content at FESPA, ISA Sign Expo, and PRINTING United that attract high-value prospects, (4) Customer adoption and satisfaction scores - ensuring HP customers achieve the performance outcomes promised in marketing materials. A partnership with Tedlar would enable HP Marketing to create technical guides, durability comparison studies, and co-branded content that differentiates HP printing systems in competitive evaluations, while providing tangible evidence that HP-printed graphics with Tedlar overlaminates deliver industry-leading outdoor performance.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: This VP owns go-to-market strategy, messaging, and customer education for HP's Large Format Printing division. They're responsible for articulating the value proposition of HP Latex, Stitch, and DesignJet printer lines to sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and print service providers. Their scope includes campaign development, event strategy, content creation, and partner marketing programs. They likely report to a Chief Marketing Officer or division General Manager, and oversee teams covering product marketing, demand generation, event marketing, and customer advocacy. Decision authority includes partner selection for co-marketing initiatives, event booth strategy, and technical content development.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: HP's customer base directly uses Tedlar's core applications: (1) Signs and graphics - HP Latex printer customers producing outdoor signage and banners would apply Tedlar overlaminates to extend graphic lifespan from typical 3-5 years to 12-20+ years, (2) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics - HP Latex users creating vehicle wraps could offer Tedlar protection to reduce warranty claims from UV damage and graffiti, (3) Architectural graphics and building wraps - HP Latex R Series customers printing rigid panels for building facades would benefit from Tedlar's weather resistance and graffiti resistance, (4) Outdoor advertising - Print service providers using HP equipment for billboards and transit advertising could differentiate with Tedlar's proven outdoor performance. The VP of Marketing would care because these use cases provide measurable proof points for HP's own durability messaging, enabling them to substantiate claims like 'graphics that withstand the test of time' with validated field data.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This role is measured on brand perception, market share in outdoor graphics segments, lead generation quality and volume from trade shows, and customer satisfaction scores. They personally care about solving: (1) Credibility gap - HP markets outdoor durability but lacks third-party validation or recommended finishing materials to prove it, (2) Event differentiation - at FESPA, ISA Sign Expo, and PRINTING United, HP competes with Canon, Epson, and Roland for attention; co-marketing with Tedlar provides unique booth content and demonstrations, (3) Customer success stories - they need case studies showing HP customers achieving measurable ROI and performance outcomes with validated material choices, (4) Competitive positioning - in enterprise sales cycles, buyers ask 'what finishing materials do you recommend?' and HP lacks authoritative answers. Tedlar solves these by providing proven performance data, co-branded technical guides, joint customer case studies, and validation that HP-printed graphics with Tedlar overlaminates deliver industry-leading outdoor performance. This directly supports their KPIs around thought leadership, customer adoption rates, and competitive win rates.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: HP is confirmed for PRINTING United Expo 2025 (October 22-24, Orlando) with a 4,000-square-foot booth, creating immediate opportunity to discuss co-marketing presence or booth integration. The company recently launched HP Latex 700/800 series with white ink capability and the Latex R530 hybrid printer, meaning they're actively developing launch messaging and positioning materials where Tedlar could provide differentiation. HP attended ISA Sign Expo 2025 and exhibited at The Sign Show 2025 after six-year absence, signaling renewed focus on outdoor graphics market penetration. HP's messaging already includes 'resists yellowing over time' and 'withstand the test of time' - language that aligns perfectly with Tedlar's value propositions, indicating readiness for materials partnership conversations. The VP of Marketing is likely planning Q4 2025 and 2026 campaign calendars now, making this an ideal window to propose co-marketing initiatives.

personalization_hooks.hook: HP actively markets 'outdoor durability' and 'graphics that withstand the test of time,' but lacks validated finishing material recommendations to substantiate these claims
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as the missing piece in HP's durability story—acknowledge their strong messaging, then offer third-party validated data and field-proven performance to turn marketing claims into measurable customer outcomes

personalization_hooks.hook: HP exhibiting at PRINTING United Expo 2025 with 4,000-square-foot booth and recently launched Latex R530 and 700/800 series targeting outdoor applications
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their upcoming booth presence and new product launches, propose co-marketing opportunity to create differentiated booth content, technical demonstrations, or customer success stories that separate HP from Canon, Epson, and Roland competitors

personalization_hooks.hook: VP of Marketing needs proof points to demonstrate ROI for HP customers choosing validated finishing materials versus commodity overlaminates
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar partnership as enabling customer advocacy content—offer to co-develop case studies showing measurable warranty claim reduction, maintenance cost savings, and customer satisfaction improvements when HP customers specify Tedlar protection for outdoor graphics

recommended_approach: Lead with alignment on shared messaging—acknowledge HP's existing outdoor durability positioning and propose Tedlar as a strategic partner to validate those claims with measurable field data. Frame the conversation around enabling HP's marketing objectives (thought leadership, event differentiation, customer success stories) rather than selling a material. Suggest a brief exploratory call to discuss co-marketing opportunities around upcoming PRINTING United presence or new product launches.
